messages:
Alex Chen: Synapse Health: final pre-kickoff check. They want a 3-week POC focused on retrieval+rerank, agent-assist triage, and concise clinical summaries. Need a clear timeline, success criteria, infra ask, and pricing options to send today.
Maria Patel: Draft POC plan: 3 weeks total. Week0 (prep): access + data checklist + ingest sample set. Week1 (baseline): run evals for relevance, extraction accuracy, latency. Week2 (opt + demo): tuning, small dedicated run, and final acceptance. Deliverables: eval spreadsheet, prompt bank, performance runbook, cost estimate.
Jamal Khan: SE notes: I can cover Week0 kickoff (3 hours) and Week2 tuning (half day). Request: customer to provide eval set of ~40 labeled cases, expected p95 latency target, and a list of top 10 failure modes they care about.
Tayla Singh: Ops/security: If they plan to send PHI, we must have signed BAA and TOU first. KMS options: customer-managed KMS supported but adds ~7 business days. Private VPC/on-prem requires ~10 business days for VPN + certs. Also need retention policy ask: do they want logs forwarded to their SIEM?
Luis Romero: Pricing options to propose: A) Hosted metered: no upfront, default throughput, B) Short reserved pool: 2 GPUs for the POC (fixed monthly uplift), C) Private install (quote after architecture). For ballpark numbers I need estimated tokens/day and expected concurrency.
Alex Chen: Success criteria proposal (draft): 1) Retrieval recall@5 >= 0.75 on their labeled set; 2) Entity extraction F1 >= 0.82 for meds/doses; 3) Summaries rated >=4/5 by SME sample (10 items); 4) p95 latency < 1.0s for typical 256-token responses. Include an explicit "no unredacted PHI" clause for dataset handling.
Maria Patel: Also add a rollback threshold: if any metric drops >8% vs baseline after tuning, revert and flag. Demo checklist: 8 demo prompts, live dashboard, and a 15-min exec summary slide.
Jamal Khan: Starter prompt examples to ask them to fill out:
```
- "Summarize latest encounter focusing on diagnosis and next steps for PCP."
- "From this note extract meds and dosages as structured JSON."
- "Given patient history, list 3 prioritized follow-ups with rationale."
```
Sales Bot: Reminder: POC legal checklist link: https://redwood.internal/legal/poc-quickcheck (requires BAA for PHI).
Tayla Singh: Security ask: provide SOC2 attestation, SAML/IdP details, required log retention window, and whether SIEM forwarding is mandatory. Request them to complete security questionnaire sections 1-4 within 48 hours.
Luis Romero: If they can commit <=150k tokens/day we can do reserved 2-GPU for the POC at reduced uplift. If >500k tokens/day suggest 3+ GPUs. Ill draft two price bands and mark assumptions.
Alex Chen: Action items: Maria send updated timeline + deliverables to customer (today), Jamal post eval template + prompt file (today), Tayla send infra/security questionnaire (today), Luis send pricing bands and assumptions (today). I'll set kickoff invite and cc legal if PHI is mentioned.
Maria Patel: Sending now. cc @Jamal Khan @Tayla Singh @Luis Romero.
Jamal Khan: I uploaded eval template to the shared drive. Pls paste customer examples into it.
Tayla Singh: Note for sales: flag private deployment lead time in the email if customer requests on-prem or VPC.
Alex Chen: Thanks all. If they push on contract timing escalate to legal.sales. Will update thread after kickoff.
